output_list.criticism: The mintTokens function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It can increase the total supply, which has a higher severity and profitability score.
The transfer function has a wrong logic vulnerability. It allows transfers to the zero address, which is a critical issue.
The approve function has a bad randomness vulnerability. It allows attackers to grant a large amount of tokens to a malicious contract.
The transferFrom function has a wrong logic vulnerability. It allows transfers to the zero address, which is a critical issue.
The blacklistAccount function has an access control vulnerability. It can blacklist a large amount of assets, which has a higher severity and profitability score.
